==Usage== 
{{Armor art infobox
| name = 
| profession = 
| campaign = 
| pvp = 
| pvpreward = 
| femaleimage = 
| maleimage =
| gallery =
}}
===Parameters=== ; name : Optional. Defaults to page name. ; profession : Which profession the armor art is available to. Defaults to "Any". ; campaign : Can be a [[campaign]], [[expansion]], [[special event]], [[Beyond]] chapter or [[storyline]]. For a list of possible parameters, see [[Template:Infobox campaign row]].
Note: this parameter is named campaign for backwards compatibility. ; pvp : If the armor art is used in PvP, put its name here. It is hidden if left blank. ; pvpreward : Optional. Used to categorize PvP reward items. Possible values are Basic and Fancy. ; femaleimage : For specifying another image name than the standard. '''Not recommended''' ; maleimage : For specifying another image name than the standard. '''Not recommended''' ; gallery : For specifying the gallery locations. Please follow the following naming convention " ". ; specialgallery : For specifying a non-standard gallery link, for use with articles about only one armor piece, often headgear. Please follow the following naming convention " " If no gallery or specialgallery parameter is specified, there will be no gallery links. ==Examples== For the standard [[Ranger Elite Drakescale armor]] 
{{armor art infobox
| profession = Ranger
| campaign = [[Prophecies]]
| pvp = Elite Drakescale
| pvpreward = Basic
| maleimage = [[Image:Ranger Elite Drakescale armor m.jpg|135px]]
| gallery = ranger Elite Drakescale 
}}
For the [[Ranger Tamer Mask]] 
{{armor art infobox
| profession = Ranger
| campaign = [[Prophecies]]
| pvp = Tamer Mask
| specialgallery = ranger Tamer Mask
}}
